summary: Wahab called Gaza a genocide at a candidate forum, in a state resolution she introduced in August 2026, and in reported statements, and cosponsored the federal Block the Bombs Act. She voted No in September 2026 on a measure to defund universities hosting Israel boycotts. UDP and affiliates spent over $2.5 million opposing her. CAIR Action endorsed her; Vote for Peace rated her an Ally. She is a confirmed pro-Palestine Muslim community member, and her platform prioritizes diplomacy over force.
